note: California State Parks campground in loops on the marine terrace above El Capitan Beach on the Gaviota coast, between US-101 and the ocean bluff. Many sites look out over the Santa Barbara Channel, and a stairway leads down to the beach. Several sites are paved for RVs only. The lower loop (sites 1-28) was closed for trail work in 2026. --Claude
summary: El Capitan SB: open with restrictions after the Sept 2025-June 2026 full closure; lower loop 1-28 closed for trail work in 2026 but booked from April 2027; first-come 1 Dec-30 Mar; every site $45; pads 23-39 ft (brochure: some to 42); bayview kept (bluff-top terrace, coastal-walk lead). Stored website page_id=602 is Chumash Painted Cave -> 601. Pin in the beach parking lot, ~285 m from the loops.
flags: WEBSITE WRONG: stored https://www.parks.ca.gov/?page_id=602 is Chumash Painted Cave SHP. El Capitan SB is https://www.parks.ca.gov/?page_id=601 (ReserveCalifornia's own Url for PlaceId 8).
PIN: stored 34.4595,-120.0254 is in the beach day-use parking lot below the terrace. Suggested 34.4617,-120.0270 (mean of the RC Lower/Middle/Upper section points; loops visible on imagery), ~285 m.

WATERFRONT bayview kept (not --AWH): sites on the open marine terrace, southern Upper and Middle loop sites ~60-150 m back from the bluff edge with open views over the channel. Not on-water: the sites sit atop a bluff above the beach (stairway access) and the beach parking lot lies below. LEAD: coastal walk could fit - an easy walk via the park's own stairway and beach, with US-101 and the railroad on the inland side, not between camp and shore. Reviewer's choice between bayview and coastal walk.

STATUS: page banner 'Open with restrictions'; 'The lower loop (spaces 1-28) is still closed due to active trail construction'. RC shows the Lower Section out of season through December 2026 but with reservations taken from April 2027, so it looks set to reopen in spring. Status left unwritten (the park itself is open).

SITES: RC carries 113 family units (22 + 55 + 36); brochure says '130+'. Count left unset. Stored max_rig_ft 42 matches the brochure ('up to 42 feet'); RC pad lengths run 23-39 ft for most sites, so 42 is the top of the range. A 23-ft rig fits every site (shortest pad 23 ft, site 117).
No dump station is listed on the park page; facilities.dump left unset.
